capture: Pixel_10 temporary read-only Android phone emulator, 1080 × 1920, 360 dpi. Each image captures the regular running launcher. Settings and shortcut lists were staged in a disposable profile. The phone PNGs are opaque RGB screencaptures. No UI, device frame or caption was composited.
wallpapers: Seven original AI-generated wallpaper artworks staged as user-supplied backgrounds and included for recreating the looks. Paper White uses Comfer monochrome mode. These names identify sample screenshots.

research.finding: English reviews praise the monochrome option, wallpaper personalization and icon shapes. Selected comments are qualitative and do not measure listing conversion.
Participants describe uncluttered layouts, sparse shortcuts and changing wallpaper while keeping navigation familiar.
Participants reacted to warm wallpaper color and disagreed on how sparse a practical Home can be.
A peer launcher presents nature-inspired, minimalist and cozy setups coordinated around wallpaper, clock and icons. This is design precedent.
